name: Soybean Crush (GPM) Elevated March — Q2 Forward Path
description: Event study on the CBOT soybean crush spread (GPM = 11×ZL/100 + 44×ZM/2000 − ZS/100). Identifies years where the average March GPM was above the historical March seasonal mean (elevated March readings), then tracks the forward GPM path over the following 60 trading days into Q2. Shows the average forward path with min/max range band, distribution of drawdowns from the March peak, and a summary of mean-reversion frequency vs continuation.
source:
# =============================================================================
# SOYBEAN CRUSH (GPM) ELEVATED MARCH — Q2 FORWARD PATH STUDY
# =============================================================================
# GPM Formula (CBOT Board Crush): 11×ZL/100 + 44×ZM/2000 − ZS/100  ($/bushel)
# Event: Year where average March GPM > historical March mean (all prior years)
# Forward path: 60 trading days after last March bar, indexed to 0 at March peak
# =============================================================================

# --- Data: ZS (primary), ZM and ZL as reference futures ---
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
zs = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

zm_raw = reference_futures(ticker='ZM')()
zm = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(zm_raw.o, zm_raw.h, zm_raw.l, zm_raw.c, zm_raw.v, zm_raw.oi, zm_raw.s)

zl_raw = reference_futures(ticker='ZL')()
zl = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(zl_raw.o, zl_raw.h, zl_raw.l, zl_raw.c, zl_raw.v, zl_raw.oi, zl_raw.s)

# --- GPM Calculation ---
# CBOT Board Crush: 11 lbs oil × ZL(cents/lb)/100 + 44 lbs meal × ZM($/ton)/2000 − ZS(cents/bu)/100
gpm = 11.0 * zl.c / 100.0 + 44.0 * zm.c / 2000.0 - zs.c / 100.0

# --- Calendar extraction ---
month_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.month)(index())
year_num  = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.year)(index())

# --- March GPM: isolate March bars ---
is_march = month_num == 3
march_gpm = where(is_march, gpm)

# --- Year-level March average: use barssince to detect last bar of March ---
# Last bar of March = first bar of April (month transitions from 3 to 4)
is_april_first = (month_num == 4) and (month_num != (month_num >> 1))

# Compute rolling mean of GPM during March for the current year
# We use a 23-bar window (max trading days in March) to capture the month's average
# but only evaluate it at the March/April boundary
march_avg_this_year = where(is_april_first, ma(period=23, type=MAType.sma)(march_gpm))

# Forward-fill the March average through the year so we can compare on any bar
march_avg_ffilled = ffill(march_avg_this_year)

# --- Historical March mean: expanding mean of all prior year March averages ---
# cumulative mean of march_avg_this_year gives the expanding average
# We lag by 1 year (use the value from the prior April boundary) to avoid look-ahead
march_avg_expanding = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_valid(march_avg_this_year), march_avg_this_year))
# Lag by 1 occurrence to get "all prior years" mean (exclude current year)
hist_march_mean = valuewhen(occurrence=1)(is_april_first, march_avg_expanding)
hist_march_mean_ffilled = ffill(hist_march_mean)

# --- Elevated March flag: current year March avg > historical March mean ---
# Evaluate at April 1st boundary (when we know the full March average)
is_elevated_march = is_valid(march_avg_this_year) and is_valid(hist_march_mean_ffilled) and march_avg_this_year > hist_march_mean_ffilled

# --- Forward path: 60 trading days after the elevated March ---
# bars_since_event counts bars since the last elevated March signal
bars_since_event = coalesce(barssince()(is_elevated_march), 9999)

# In the 60-bar window after an elevated March, compute GPM change from the event bar
# GPM at the event bar (last bar of March / first bar of April)
gpm_at_event = ffill(where(is_elevated_march, gpm))

# GPM change from March peak (indexed to 0 at event bar)
gpm_change_from_peak = where(
    is_valid(gpm_at_event) and bars_since_event <= 60,
    gpm - gpm_at_event
)

# Bar index within the 60-day window (x-axis for forward path chart)
bar_index_in_window = where(bars_since_event <= 60, bars_since_event)

# --- Max drawdown from March peak within 60-day window ---
# For each event, track the minimum GPM change (worst drawdown) in the window
# We capture the 60-day min change per event year
min_change_in_window = where(is_elevated_march, cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Min)(gpm_change_from_peak))

# --- Mean-reversion flag: GPM lower at day 60 than at March peak ---
# Capture the GPM change at exactly bar 60 after the event
is_day60 = bars_since_event == 60
gpm_change_at_day60 = where(is_day60, gpm_change_from_peak)

# Mean-reverted = GPM at day 60 is below March peak (change < 0)
mean_reverted = where(is_day60, 1.0 if (is_valid(gpm_change_from_peak) and gpm_change_from_peak < 0.0) else 0.0)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 1: Event Markers — Elevated March GPM years
# =============================================================================
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Elevated March Crush (GPM)',
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='March Avg GPM ($/bu)', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='Hist March Mean ($/bu)', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='Year', dp=0, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(march_avg_ffilled, hist_march_mean_ffilled, year_num, is_elevated_march)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 2: Forward Path Chart — Average 60-day GPM path after elevated March
# Mean line + min/max range band, x-axis = bars since March peak
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Average GPM Path in Q2 After Elevated March (60 Trading Days)',
    category='1. Crush Spread Q2 Forward Path',
    x_axis_label='Trading Days After March Peak',
    y_axis_label='GPM Change from March Peak ($/bu)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    smooth=True,
    data_labels=False,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='March Peak Level')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Avg GPM Path', color=Color.Blue, agg=AggregationType.Mean),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Best Case', color=Color.Gray, agg=AggregationType.Max, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, area=False),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Worst Case', color=Color.Gray, agg=AggregationType.Min, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, area=False)
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=bar_index_in_window, y_values=(gpm_change_from_peak, gpm_change_from_peak, gpm_change_from_peak))

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 3: Drawdown Distribution — Boxplot of max drawdown from March peak
# =============================================================================
boxplot(
    title='Distribution of Max Drawdown from March Peak (60-Day Window)',
    category='1. Crush Spread Q2 Forward Path',
    y_axis_label='Max GPM Drawdown from March Peak ($/bu)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    median_color=Color.White,
    show_data_labels=True,
    show_outliers=True,
    order=2
)(values=min_change_in_window)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 4: Summary Table — Mean-reversion stats
# =============================================================================
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='GPM Q2 Mean-Reversion Summary (Elevated March Years)',
        row_size=2,
        col_size=3,
        row_headers=['60-Day Outcome', 'Drawdown Stats'],
        col_headers=['N Events', 'Mean-Reversion Rate', 'Median 60d Change ($/bu)'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, dp=0, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, info='Number of elevated March years detected'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, info='Fraction of years where GPM was lower at day 60 vs March peak (0-1 scale)'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, info='Median GPM change at day 60 vs March peak ($/bu)'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, info='Worst max drawdown from March peak across all event years'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, info='Median max drawdown from March peak'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, info='Best max drawdown (least negative) from March peak')
        ]
    ),
    category='1. Crush Spread Q2 Forward Path',
    order=0
)(mean_reverted, gpm_change_at_day60, gpm_change_at_day60, min_change_in_window, min_change_in_window, min_change_in_window)
